response.justification: While Bogdan is a highly skilled and experienced software engineer with exceptional craftsmanship, testing practices, and mentoring abilities, this role requires deep current C++ expertise and industrial domain knowledge that are largely absent from his background. His C++ experience is minimal and over 10 years old, his career has focused on web and cloud technologies rather than systems programming, and he lacks experience with industrial automation, cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), and industrial protocols (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA). Although his adaptability and learning ability are strong, the gap between his current expertise and the role's core requirements makes him unsuitable for a senior C++ developer position requiring immediate technical productivity.
strengths: Exceptional software craftsmanship with proven expertise in TDD, CI/CD, code quality practices, and testing frameworks (Fluent-Asserts, Trial)
Strong technical leadership and mentoring demonstrated through teaching workshops, creating Selenium courses, and managing open-source projects with community impact
Proven ability to master diverse technology stacks and solve complex problems across 20 years of industry experience, showing strong analytical and adaptive capabilities
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (6 months at National Instruments in 2014-2015); lacks current proficiency with STL, advanced OOP in C++, and systems programming required for senior-level C++ development

No background in industrial automation, IoT systems, secure development lifecycle (SDL), IEC 62443 standards, or industrial protocols (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850) essential for this manufacturing-focused role

Career trajectory focused on web, cloud, and high-level languages (JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js) for the past 10+ years; lacks embedded systems and low-level multi-threaded networking programming experience needed for on-premises solutions
